Description: Verify POST /sandbox/reset on the QA stack answers 403 'Sandbox mode is not enabled' and touches NOTHING - QA deliberately leaves SANDBOX_MODE unset, and this endpoint deletes the entire database when the gate is open, so the 403 here is the permanent regression proof that the gate defaults CLOSED
PreRequisites: Execute SQL: INSERT INTO owners (id, name, email, subscription_active) VALUES (<dynamic_id>, 'Survivor Owner', 'survivor_<dynamic_id>@test.com', true);
ExpectedResult: HTTP 403 Forbidden. JSON contains {'detail': 'Sandbox mode is not enabled'}
Post-Assertions: Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM owners WHERE id = <dynamic_id> -> Expected: 1 (the seeded row SURVIVED - the reset did not run)
Teardown: Execute SQL: DELETE FROM owners WHERE id = <dynamic_id>;
